subject: Procurement: vendor setup, PO vs card, and intake forms (Zenith Retail)
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@zenithretail.com>, Procurement <procurement@zenithretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 13:08:00 -0800
Subject: Procurement: vendor setup, PO vs card, and intake forms (Zenith Retail)

Hi Samantha / Procurement team —

Great to meet you earlier today. Quick recap from our discovery and next steps so procurement can get us set up: 

- What procurement path do you typically use for new vendors like Redwood? (PO on net terms, or card/marketplace for initial pilots?)
- Can you confirm the procurement POC (name + email) we should loop in for vendor setup?
- I’m attaching our standard vendor packet (W-9, vendor questionnaire, banking/ACH stub). Please let us know any specific fields Zenith requires on the intake form.

Attachments: redwood_vendor_packet.pdf (includes W-9 and vendor info)

Next steps we propose:
1) If you prefer PO: please send vendor intake form / vendor portal link and payment terms so we can complete vendor setup.
2) If you prefer credit card/marketplace: let us know which marketplace and your procurement contact so we can enable the billing flow.

Happy to jump on a quick follow-up call with your procurement lead to walk through the packet if that helps.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
dylan_brooks@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@zenithretail.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@zenithretail.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 09:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Procurement: vendor setup, PO vs card, and intake forms (Zenith Retail)

Thanks for the follow-up, Dylan.

Quick answers: we generally use PO for any contract > $10k annually; small pilot engagements can be routed via our procurement card or through our cloud marketplace (we use CloudMarket).

Procurement POC is Jacob Ross (jacob.ross@zenithretail.com) — I’ve looped him on this thread. I’m attaching Zenith’s vendor intake form; we need a completed copy, a W-9, and banking details for ACH setup. Also include a contact for invoicing (name + email).

Attachments: zenith_vendor_intake_form.xlsx

Samantha Lee
Director, Strategic Partnerships
Zenith Retail
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: Jacob Ross <jacob.ross@zenithretail.com>, Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@zenithretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Procurement: vendor setup, PO vs card, and intake forms (Zenith Retail)

Hi Jacob — great to meet you (virtually). Thanks Samantha for the intro.

Attached are the items you requested: W-9 (W-9-redwood.pdf) and a short ACH/banking stub (ACH-setup-instructions.pdf). I’ve also completed the top section of your vendor intake form where it’s administrative — see note in the form where we left blanks for your required fields.

Summary / ask from Redwood: 
- Preferred payment method: we can accept PO on NET30 terms for the annual commitment (deal id ZR-2026-0114), or you can route an initial pilot via CloudMarket using corporate card. Which do you prefer?
- Billing contact: please confirm who should receive invoices (name + email).
- Vendor portal: if Zenith requires us to register in a vendor portal, please send the registration link and any additional documents.

I’ve cc’d Marissa (vendor ops) to handle the formal packet and bank details. If convenient, we can schedule a 20-minute call Monday to complete the intake form together.

Attachments: W-9-redwood.pdf, ACH-setup-instructions.pdf, partial_filled_zenith_vendor_intake_form.xlsx

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jacob Ross <jacob.ross@zenithretail.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@zenithretail.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Procurement: vendor setup, PO vs card, and intake forms (Zenith Retail)

Hi Jacob — looping in to get us officially set up. Per Dylan’s note: vendor packet attached with Redwood’s W-9 and banking breakdown for ACH.

For your queue:
- Attached: banking_details_redwood.pdf and vendor_setup_guide.docx. The vendor_setup_guide includes the remit-to address and our preferred invoice format (PDF via email).
- For billing: invoices can be sent to invoices@redwood.com and cc: accounting_ops@redwood.com.
- Payment terms: we can accept PO/NET30 for committed annual contracts; for short pilots under $10k we’re fine with card or marketplace billing.

If Zenith requires a vendor portal registration, please send the link and any vendor code fields and we’ll register today. If helpful, I’m available Monday 10–12 PT for a short setup call.

Attachments: banking_details_redwood.pdf, vendor_setup_guide.docx

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Vendor Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
(End of thread)
